description: The wger shape and its unsafe counterpart. django_login is the identity change that matters in the first function, and Django rotates the session key as part of that operation; the namespaced trainer.identity write after it is only application metadata. The second function invokes an application login over the request without an intrinsic or explicit rotation, so only that identity-change call is session fixation.

expected.note: the application changes the request's authenticated identity and never rotates its session identifier
